facts.fact: Madhavi contests the fifth clause (pass by contract), citing the dead Lekha, Orma, Kani and Swathi; Devan amends it so no contract binds a member to stand where she has not voted to stand, and the five terms carry unanimously.
At the dusk namings Sajan comes to the edge, stops, and steps back without naming; Sanu watches. Only Lata names among the four unready guards, consistent with three crown leaves remaining.
